newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-Hoare cuts media sector estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Hoare cuts media sector estimates.

text.p: Earnings estimates for leading UK media stocks were cut at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett to reflect the continuing strength of sterling, market sources said on Thursday.
For Reuters Holdings Plc, Hoare analysts cut their 1997 pre-tax profit forecasts to 699 million stg from 725 million but retained an "undervalued" rating on the stock, sources said.

For Reed International Plc, Hoare cut to 856 million stg from 867 million, for Carlton Communications Plc it cut to 336 million stg from 343 million and for Pearson Plc it cut to 296 million stg from 311 million.
Hoare analysts rated Reed and Pearson as "hold" and only Carlton merited a "buy" stance.
Reuters shares, hit by talk of cuts in earnings estimates on Wednesday, were down another 8p at 560 by 0803 GMT in volume of just over half a million shares.
Pearson was unchanged at 687-1/2, Reed was up 3-1/2p at 586-1/2 and Carlton was down 5p at 502-1/2.
